image_description: A close-up photograph featuring two prominent white daisies with bright yellow centers against a dark, blurred background. A third partial daisy is visible in the top left corner. The flowers exhibit classic composite structure with radiating white ray florets and textured yellow disc florets.

To check for subtle fusion between adjacent white petals or bleeding into the yellow center, which are common AI artifacts in dense floral structures.
To assess if the blur and texture details are consistent with optical photography or if they exhibit digital smearing/noise patterns typical of generative models.
